visualStyleNotes: Data And Statistics, Math palette, Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A standing scoreboard table with a header, data rows, a sort control, and a chart plate that pops out bars. Soft neutral studio light, no rim-light glow, no bloom, no emissive. Strong saturated color reserved for the small flat hotspot dots (amber / molecular-green / grid-blue from the Math palette). Specimen-quality clean-3D, not cartoon, not cluttered.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Table frame: warm paper panel (roughness ~0.5). Header: warm amber-tinted strip with ink labels. Data rows: warm paper strips with ink text, subtle grid lines. Sort control: small warm-grey plate. Chart plate: warm paper panel with rising bar shapes (roughness ~0.5). Mat: soft warm-grey (roughness ~0.85). No emissive channels — highlights handled by app runtime UI.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: tables as organized data — a class scoreboard grid (Name, Score, Team) with five rows; rows highlight on trace; sort reorders by score; 'to chart' pops the scores out as bars.

GEOMETRY: A standing table frame with a header row (Name, Score, Team) and five data rows of cells. Tracing a row highlights the whole strip. 'Sort by score' animates the rows re-ordering. Tapping a cell isolates and highlights it. 'To chart' slides a bar-chart plate beside the table whose bars match each score value.

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) table frame; (2) header row; (3) data rows; (4) bar-chart plate.

CAMERA: three-quarter from front-left, slightly above, frames the full grid; labels legible. Budget 6-10k triangles. Named nodes: TableFrame, HeaderRow, DataRows, CellHighlighter, SortControl, ChartPlate, Bars. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
